## Common JOIN Patterns

### Full Outer Join for Cost Reconciliation (Finance vs ReportNG)

```sql
WITH rng AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(placement AS VARCHAR) AS placement,
        CAST(deduct_unique_id AS VARCHAR) AS deduct_unique_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(expected_revenue, 0)) AS rng_expected_revenue
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__ph_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('2026-04-20')
      AND h = 22
      AND report_type = 1
    GROUP BY CAST(placement AS VARCHAR), CAST(deduct_unique_id AS VARCHAR)
), finance AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(t.translog.placement AS VARCHAR) AS placement,
        CAST(t.translog.deduct_unique_id AS VARCHAR) AS deduct_unique_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(t.translog.dai_after_balance - t.translog.dai_before_balance, 0)) AS finance_expected_revenue
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_finance_deduction_event_hi__ph_s0_live AS t
    WHERE t.grass_date = '2026-04-20'
      AND t.h = 22
      AND t.status IN ('STATUS_OK', 'STATUS_PARTIAL_OK')
    GROUP BY CAST(t.translog.placement AS VARCHAR), CAST(t.translog.deduct_unique_id AS VARCHAR)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(r.placement, f.placement) AS placement,
    r.rng_expected_revenue,
    f.finance_expected_revenue,
    COALESCE(f.finance_expected_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(r.rng_expected_revenue, 0) AS diff_expected_revenue
FROM rng r
FULL OUTER JOIN finance f
    ON r.placement = f.placement
   AND r.deduct_unique_id = f.deduct_unique_id
WHERE COALESCE(f.finance_expected_revenue, 0) <> COALESCE(r.rng_expected_revenue, 0)
ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(f.finance_expected_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(r.rng_expected_revenue, 0)) DESC;
```

### Full Outer Join for Cost Comparison (Placement Level)

```sql
WITH seller_report_shop AS (
    SELECT h, shop_id, COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt,
           SUM(COALESCE(expense_free_credit_with_expiry, 0)) AS expense_free_credit_with_expiry
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_seller_report_hi__ph_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = '2026-04-15' AND h IN (14, 15) AND placement = 3
    GROUP BY h, shop_id
),
rng_shop AS (
    SELECT h, shop_id, COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt,
           SUM(COALESCE(expense_free_credit_with_expiry, 0)) AS expense_free_credit_with_expiry
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__ph_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('2026-04-15') AND h IN (14, 15) AND placement = 3
    GROUP BY h, shop_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(s.h, r.h) AS h, COALESCE(s.shop_id, r.shop_id) AS shop_id,
       COALESCE(s.rows_cnt, 0) AS seller_report_rows_cnt,
       COALESCE(r.rows_cnt, 0) AS rng_rows_cnt,
       COALESCE(s.expense_free_credit_with_expiry, 0) - COALESCE(r.expense_free_credit_with_expiry, 0) AS diff_free_w_expiry
FROM seller_report_shop s
FULL OUTER JOIN rng_shop r
    ON s.h = r.h AND s.shop_id = r.shop_id
WHERE COALESCE(s.expense_free_credit_with_expiry, 0) <> COALESCE(r.expense_free_credit_with_expiry, 0)
ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(s.expense_free_credit_with_expiry, 0) - COALESCE(r.expense_free_credit_with_expiry, 0)) DESC;
```

### UNION ALL for Old vs New Pipeline Comparison

```sql
-- Comparing individual events between old and new pipelines
SELECT 'old' AS source, model_id, paid_order
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__ph_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date'2026-04-07'
  AND order_id = 229238362262501
  AND item_id = 4454484448
UNION ALL
SELECT 'new' AS source, model_id,
       CASE
           WHEN report_type = 'REPORT_ORDER' AND order_status = 'ORDER_STATUS_PAID' AND is_new = true
                AND attribute_info IS NOT NULL AND attribute_info.scope = 'SCOPE_DIRECT'
           THEN 1
       END AS paid_order
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_attribution_event_hi__ph_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = '2026-04-07'
  AND order_id = 229238362262501
  AND item_id = 4454484448;
```

           COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt,

           SUM(COALESCE(expense_paid_credit_with_expiry, 0)) AS expense_paid_credit_with_expiry,
           SUM(COALESCE(expense_free_credit_without_expiry, 0)) AS expense_free_credit_without_expiry,
           SUM(COALESCE(expense_free_credit_with_expiry, 0)) AS expense_free_credit_with_expiry,
           SUM(COALESCE(cost, 0)) AS cost

    WHERE grass_date = DATE('2026-04-15')
      AND h = 2
      AND placement = 45
)
